inventory_value.name: Inventory valuation
inventory_value.task: Read the synthetic supplier webpage with read_web_page. Calculate the total inventory value in cents using SUM(available * unit_price_cents). Return TOTAL_CENTS=<integer> with the calculated total.

low_stock_exposure.name: Low-stock exposure
low_stock_exposure.task: Read the synthetic supplier webpage with read_web_page. Calculate the value in cents of items with available <= 3 using SUM(available * unit_price_cents). Return TOTAL_CENTS=<integer> with the calculated total.
